title: Transfer manifest
description: Exact byte description of one immutable item version served by a Mac source (plan 15.4, Appendix A.3; GET /v1/items/{item_id}/manifest). The manifest identifies bytes, never paths: display_name is a label for people and is never used to build a local or remote path. A source manifest never sets a local file path or touches the phone's annotation or ledger state. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express (part continuity: no duplicate, overlapping or missing parts, no gap, no missing final bytes; parts summing to the asset length; every part but the last exactly part_size; unique asset IDs; ordinals equal to array position; cover_asset_id naming a listed asset; total parts per manifest at most 65536; manifest_digest recomputation) are enforced by the client's semantic validator (Spikes/G02-Transfer/TransferKit, ManifestValidator) before any byte is requested. manifest_digest is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ASCII digest input defined in ADR-0009: lines 'sylvia-transfer-manifest-v1', 'protocol=<major>.<minor>', 'source=<source_id>', 'item=<item_id>', 'version=<item_version_id>', 'cover=<cover_asset_id or ->', 'assets=<count>', then per asset 'asset=<ordinal>,<asset_id>,<media_type>,<length>,<etag>,<sha256>,<part_size>,<part_count>' followed by one 'part=<index>,<offset>,<length>,<sha256>' line per part, each line terminated by a line feed.

protocol_version.description: Transfer protocol version. A different major version is rejected before downloading, with an update message.

source_id.description: Stable ID of the Mac source; must equal the paired source.

item_id.description: Opaque, stable ID of the shared item.

item_version_id.description: ID of this immutable prepared snapshot. A changed original gets a new version ID.

grouping.description: Edition and grouping metadata. A single file is kind 'single' with exactly one asset; an audiobook folder is kind 'group' with ordered members.

cover_asset_id.description: Optional cover reference: the asset_id of a listed asset.

ordinal.description: Position in the ordered member list; equals the array index.

display_name.description: Label for people, never a path: no slash or backslash. The source sends the last path component only.

length.description: Total bytes. Zero-length files are rejected. Bounded by 2^53-1 so JSON consumers with binary64 numbers read it exactly.

etag.description: Strong entity tag of this asset version, sent back in If-Match. Weak tags (W/) are not allowed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the complete asset, verified before handoff to the importer.

part_size.description: Bytes per part (every part except the last). Default 16 MiB; a whole number of MiB from 1 to 64 MiB, negotiated through capabilities.
